item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #MINPRSD
Issued at 02:00 PM 05 September 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #SultanKudarat(Palimbang, Kalamansig), #Sarangani(Maitum), #Bukidnon(Malitbog, Libona, Baungon, Quezon, Maramag, Kitaotao), #MisamisOriental(Tagoloan, CagayanDeOroCity, Villanueva, Talisayan, Balingoan, Jasaan), #ZamboangaDelNorte(Siayan, Sindangan), #ZamboangaDelSur(Lakewood, Bayog, Tigbao, Kumalarang, PagadianCity, Labangan), #ZamboangaSibugay(Buug, Diplahan, Siay), #LanaoDelSur(Butig, Masiu, PoonaBayabao, Maguing, Bubong, TagoloanII), #MaguindanaoDelNorte(Buldon), #NorthCotabato(Alamada, Banisilan), #AgusanDelSur(Loreto), #DavaoDelNorte(Kapalong, CityOfSamal, CityOfPanabo, Carmen, CityOfTagum, BraulioE.Dujali), #DavaoDeOro(Mabini, Maco, Pantukan) and #DavaoCity within the next 1-2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #AgusanDelSur(Esperanza, SanLuis, LaPaz), #AgusanDelNorte(LasNieves, Buenavista, Carmen, Nasipit), #Bukidnon(ImpasugOng, CityOfMalaybalay, Sumilao, Lantapan, ManoloFortich, Pangantucan, Talakag, Kalilangan, SanFernando, Cabanglasan, CityOfValencia), #LanaoDelSur(Bumbaran, Wao, LumbaBayabao), #DavaoDelNorte(Talaingod), #DavaoDeOro(NewBataan, Maragusan), #MisamisOriental(GingoogCity, Medina, Claveria, Magsaysay), #ZamboangaDelSur(Dumingag, Midsalip, Sominot, Mahayag), #SultanKudarat(Sen.NinoyAquino, Bagumbayan, Isulan), #SouthCotabato(LakeSebu, Surallah, SantoNiño and Norala) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
